notes:
Account snapshot: Veridian Integration Labs (insuretech) — evaluating Redwood to replace legacy reranking + embeddings infra for claims triage and agent assist. Heavy security posture: VPC-only, SSO via Okta, HSM-backed KMS, EU data residency required.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2025-09-04: Intro call (AE Priya). Customer scoped latency target: 50-150ms p99 for chat paths, bulk embedding throughput 2500 reqs/min.
- 2025-11-10: POC kickoff (SE Liam). Setup in customer VPC using dedicated test cluster. Initial tests showed good token latency but integration friction.
- 2025-11-18: SE notes SDK gaps — no native async streaming pattern for our worker pool, Node SDK lacks reconnect/backpressure hooks. (Jira INF-1243)
- 2025-12-05: Security review escalated to SecOps. SSO test failed on SAML metadata exchange; customer wanted built-in SAML connector + SCIM provisioning. (ticket SEC-3321)
- 2026-01-12: Requested tracing hook to correlate Redwood generated request_ids with Veridian's Datadog/Jaeger traces. Team: "We need an out-of-the-box tracing hook to correlate with our Datadog traces."
- 2026-01-20: Competitor (Anthropic) demoed managed connector and a one-click SAML/SCIM flow; Veridian ran a short smoke POC with them.
- 2026-02-08: Procurement signals budget freeze; internal champion (platform lead) promoted out of org.
- 2026-02-28: AE follow-up email and Fireflies call; no reply since.

Use-case & requirements summary (shorthand):
- Workloads: live chat/agent assist (low p99 latency), embeddings for semantic search, reranking pipeline for claims prioritization.
- Scale targets: 2k concurrent chat sessions peak; embedding throughput 2.5k/min.
- Model prefs: flexible open models, ability to pin quantized variants for cost.
- Routing/fallback: multi-region routing + deterministic fallback to smaller model variant.
- Observability: must emit trace ids, span links, and token-level latency metrics into customer's APM.

What stalled the deal (root causes):
- Integration friction: Node + Python SDK missing async streaming and tracing hooks; engineering time to write wrappers looked non-trivial.
- Auth complexity: customer required fully managed SAML/SCIM + mTLS ingress pattern; current Redwood docs + sample proxy not sufficient.
- Security blockers: SecOps wanted formal SCIM connector, SOC2 attestation mapping, and an HSM KMS integration demo.
- Org change + budget: internal champion left; procurement froze Q1 FY26.
- Competitive loss: Anthropic provided a quick connector and support commitment which accelerated their POC.

AE notes / quotes:
- "If we can't ship a simple tracing hook and a Node streaming pattern, they'll build around the competitor."

Next steps / recommended playbook (short):
- Mark closed-lost in CRM with reason tags: integration_friction, security_blocker, lost_to_competitor, budget_freeze.
- Triage and open engineering RFC for: (1) Node streaming/backpressure API, (2) lightweight tracing hooks that surface request_id/span to Datadog/OTel.
- Create a security playbook sample for SCIM + Okta + HSM KMS patterns; run an internal SPA to demo HSM key wrapping.
- Re-engage timeline: schedule touch in 2026-07 after Q2 budgets; target new platform lead.

Attachments & artefacts: pricing deck, POC results, Fireflies transcripts (links above).

CRM-level sentiment: cold — high technical interest but pragmatic blockers. Re-open probability: medium if SDK + auth gaps are productized.
